Name: Kim Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]There was a request for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6486]Kim's[/url] return in the forums, and since permissions were open, I went ahead with her revival![/size]

[size=4]Kim is a shy young woman from the Gotoro Empire. She runs a branch of her family's shop selling baked goods and her family's special wine! But she's under a lot of pressure from her family to succeed. Maybe you can help her out?[/size]

[size=4]Kim comes with a full schedule and heart events at 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 hearts right now. She lives at the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48930]Boarding House[/url] and is romanceable. [/size]

[size=4]Gift Guide:[/size]
[size=4]Love: Cherry Cobbler (Included with this mod), Sweet Vermillion Wine (Included with this mod), Diamond, Blueberry Tart, Daffodil
Like: Blackberry Cobbler, Blue Jazz, Aquamarine, Fairy Rose, Sashimi
Neutral: Joja Cola
Dislike: Dandelion, Poppy, Tulip, Pumpkin Pie
Hate: Survival Burger, Any Mushroom [/size]

[size=4]Heart Guide:[/size]

[size=4]0 Hearts: Go to the Bus Stop[/size]
[size=4]2 Hearts: Enter the Saloon between 6 pm and 10 pm[/size]
[size=4]4 Hearts: Enter Town on a sunny day between 10 am and 3 pm[/size]
[size=4]6 Hearts: Enter Town on a sunny day between 10 am and 3 pm[/size]
[size=4]8 hearts: Enter the Saloon after 8 pm[/size]

[size=4]Credit for the original mod goes to ilyAoiMiyake, ItsBenter, and ExnoticTest.[/size]

[size=4]Kim came as a pretty much blank slate so I wrote the dialogue and storyline from scratch with context clues from what I could get from the original mod.[/size]

[size=4]I do plan to add 10 and 14 heart events in the future and further develop the mod as I deem necessary.[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
